records.literal_gloss: For the director. Of David. A psalm.

en.L: For the director. Of David. A psalm.
en.B: For the music director. Of David. A psalm.
en.R: For the leader of the music. A song by David.

fr.L: Au chef de chœur. De David. Un psaume.
fr.B: Au chef de chœur. De David. Psaume.
fr.R: Pour le chef des musiciens. Un chant de David.

sw.L: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Zaburi.
sw.B: Kwa kiongozi wa kwaya. Ya Daudi. Zaburi.
sw.R: Kwa kiongozi wa waimbaji. Wimbo wa Daudi.

es.L: Al director del coro. De David. Un salmo.
es.B: Al director del coro. De David. Un salmo.
es.R: Para el director de la música. Un canto escrito por David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director: the one who leads the music
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: Psalm 40:14-18 is also Psalm 70
decisions.reason: The last five verses of this psalm appear again, with small changes, as Psalm 70. A prayer of thanks (verses 2-11) turns into a cry for help (verses 12-18).

source.text: קַוֺּ֣ה קִוִּ֣יתִי יְהוָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥ט אֵ֝לַ֗י וַיִּשְׁמַ֥ע שַׁוְעָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Waiting I waited [for] YHWH, and he inclined to me and heard my cry.

en.L: Waiting, I waited for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} inclined to me and heard my cry.
en.B: I waited and kept on waiting for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bent down toward me and listened to my cry for help.
en.R: I waited and waited for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} to help me. Then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} leaned down to me and heard me cry out.

fr.L: Espérant, j’ai espéré {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est penché vers moi et a entendu mon cri.
fr.B: J’ai attendu, et attendu encore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est penché vers moi et a écouté mon appel au secours.
fr.R: J’ai attendu longtemps que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} vienne m’aider. Puis {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est penché vers moi et m’a entendu crier.

sw.L: Kungoja nilimngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaniinamia na kusikia kilio changu.
sw.B: Nilimngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nikaendelea kumngojea, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} akaniinamia na kukisikiliza kilio changu cha kuomba msaada.
sw.R: Nilimngojea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa muda mrefu anisaidie. Kisha akaniinamia na kunisikia nikilia.

es.L: Esperando, esperé {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se inclinó hacia mí y oyó mi clamor.
es.B: Esperé y seguí esperando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se inclinó hacia mí y escuchó mi grito de auxilio.
es.R: Esperé y esperé a que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me ayudara. Entonces {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se inclinó hacia mí y me oyó clamar.

decisions.choice: Waiting I waited: I waited long and hard
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled (an infinitive with the same verb), which makes it strong: he waited steadily, with hope fixed on the LORD. The word (qavah) is the waiting of hope (27:14).

decisions.choice: he inclined to me: he bent down to listen
decisions.reason: The verb is used of bending the ear to hear (17:6; 31:3). The LORD stoops to the one who calls.

source.text: וַיַּעֲלֵ֤נִי׀מִבּ֥וֹר שָׁאוֹן֮ מִטִּ֪יט הַיָּ֫וֵ֥ן וַיָּ֖קֶם עַל־סֶ֥לַע רַגְלַ֗י כּוֹנֵ֥ן אֲשֻׁרָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And he brought me up from a pit of roaring, from the mud of the mire, and set on a rock my feet; he made firm my steps.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} brought me up from a pit of roaring, from the mud of the mire, and set my feet on a rock; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made my steps firm.
en.B: He drew me up from the roaring pit, out of the clinging mud; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} planted my feet on a rock and steadied my steps.
en.R: He pulled me up out of a deep, noisy pit, out of the sticky mud. He set me on solid rock, so that I could walk without slipping.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} m’a fait monter d’une fosse de vacarme, de la boue du bourbier, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a placé mes pieds sur un rocher ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a affermi mes pas.
fr.B: Il m’a tiré de la fosse grondante, de la vase qui colle ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a posé mes pieds sur un rocher et a rendu mes pas assurés.
fr.R: Il m’a tiré d’un trou profond et bruyant, hors de la boue qui colle. Il m’a mis sur un rocher solide, pour que je puisse marcher sans glisser.

sw.L: Naye akanipandisha kutoka katika shimo la kelele, kutoka katika matope ya utelezi, akaisimamisha miguu yangu juu ya mwamba; akaziimarisha hatua zangu.
sw.B: Alinivuta juu kutoka katika shimo lenye kelele za maji, kutoka katika matope yanayonata; akaipandikiza miguu yangu juu ya mwamba na kuziimarisha hatua zangu.
sw.R: Alinivuta juu kutoka katika shimo refu lenye kelele, kutoka katika matope yanayonata. Aliniweka juu ya mwamba imara, ili niweze kutembea bila kuteleza.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} me hizo subir de una fosa de estruendo, del lodo del pantano, y puso mis pies sobre una roca; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} afirmó mis pasos.
es.B: Él me sacó de la fosa rugiente, del barro pegajoso; {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} plantó mis pies sobre una roca y dio firmeza a mis pasos.
es.R: Él me sacó de un pozo hondo y ruidoso, del lodo pegajoso. Me puso sobre una roca firme, para que pudiera caminar sin resbalar.

decisions.choice: roaring: the din of rushing water, or ruin
decisions.reason: The word (sha'on) means a roar or uproar, as of the sea (65:8). A pit of roaring may be a pit where water rushes, or, from a related root, a pit of ruin.

decisions.choice: the pit and the mire: near to death
decisions.reason: The pit is a picture of the grave and of deadly danger (28:1; 30:4; 88:5); mud in which one sinks is the same picture (69:3, 15). The rock is its opposite: firm, safe ground.

decisions.choice: so that I could walk without slipping
decisions.reason: Readable says what firm steps mean.

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֬ן בְּפִ֨י׀שִׁ֥יר חָדָשׁ֮ תְּהִלָּ֪ה לֵֽאלֹ֫הֵ֥ינוּ יִרְא֣וּ רַבִּ֣ים וְיִירָ֑אוּ וְ֝יִבְטְח֗וּ בַּיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he put in my mouth a song new, praise to our God; many will see and fear, and they will trust in YHWH.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} put in my mouth a new song, praise to our God; many will see and fear, and they will trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He gave me a new song to sing, a hymn for our God. Many people will look on and be filled with awe, and they will put their trust in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He gave me a new song to sing, a song that praises our God. Many people will see what {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done. They will be amazed, and they will trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a mis dans ma bouche un chant nouveau, une louange à notre Dieu ; beaucoup verront et craindront, et ils auront confiance en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il m’a donné un chant nouveau à chanter, un hymne pour notre Dieu. Beaucoup regarderont et seront remplis de crainte, et ils mettront leur confiance en {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il m’a donné un chant nouveau à chanter, un chant qui loue notre Dieu. Beaucoup de gens verront ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait. Ils seront émerveillés, et ils feront confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye akatia kinywani mwangu wimbo mpya, sifa kwa Mungu wetu; wengi wataona na kuogopa, nao watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Alinipa wimbo mpya wa kuimba, wimbo wa kumsifu Mungu wetu. Watu wengi wataona na kujawa na hofu takatifu, nao watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Alinipa wimbo mpya wa kuimba, wimbo wa kumsifu Mungu wetu. Watu wengi wataona yale aliyoyatenda. Watashangaa, nao watamtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} puso en mi boca un cántico nuevo, alabanza a nuestro Dios; muchos verán y temerán, y confiarán en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Él me dio un cántico nuevo para cantar, un himno para nuestro Dios. Mucha gente lo verá y se llenará de reverencia, y pondrá su confianza en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Él me dio una canción nueva para cantar, una canción que alaba a nuestro Dios. Mucha gente verá lo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho. Se asombrarán, y confiarán en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

decisions.choice: a new song: a song for a new act of rescue
decisions.reason: A new song answers something new that God has done (33:3; 96:1; 98:1). Here the LORD himself puts it in the singer's mouth.

decisions.choice: see and fear: a play on words
decisions.reason: "They will see" (yir'u) and "they will fear" (yira'u) sound almost alike. To fear the LORD is to stand in awe of him, which leads here to trust.

decisions.choice: what he has done
decisions.reason: Readable says what the many will see: the rescue of verse 3.

source.text: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי הַגֶּ֗בֶר אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֣ם יְ֭הֹוָה מִבְטַח֑וֹ וְֽלֹא־פָנָ֥ה אֶל־רְ֝הָבִ֗ים וְשָׂטֵ֥י כָזָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: How blessed [is] the man who has made YHWH his trust, and has not turned to proud [ones] and [those who] fall away [to] falsehood.

en.L: How blessed [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} who has made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} {{gender:their|his}} trust, and has not turned to the proud, or to those who stray after falsehood!
en.B: How blessed are those who make {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their trust, who do not turn to the arrogant or to those who wander off after lies!
en.R: Life is truly good for people who trust {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They do not follow proud people, or people who turn away to false gods.

fr.L: Heureux {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} qui a fait {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} sa confiance, et qui ne s’est pas tourné vers les orgueilleux ni vers ceux qui s’égarent dans le mensonge !
fr.B: Heureux ceux qui font {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur confiance, qui ne se tournent pas vers les arrogants ni vers ceux qui s’égarent à la suite du mensonge !
fr.R: Quel bonheur pour ceux qui font confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Ils ne suivent pas les orgueilleux, ni ceux qui se détournent vers de faux dieux.

sw.L: Heri mtu ambaye amemfanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa tumaini lake, wala hakuwageukia wenye kiburi, wala wale wanaopotea kufuata uongo!
sw.B: Ana heri kweli kila anayemfanya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuwa tumaini lake, asiyewageukia wenye majivuno wala wale wanaopotoka kufuata uongo!
sw.R: Maisha ni mema kweli kwa watu wanaomtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Hawawafuati watu wenye kiburi, wala watu wanaogeuka kuifuata miungu ya uongo.

es.L: ¡{{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}} que ha puesto en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su confianza, y no se ha vuelto a los soberbios, ni a los que se desvían tras la mentira!
es.B: ¡Qué dichosos son los que ponen su confianza en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, los que no se vuelven hacia los arrogantes ni hacia los que se extravían tras las mentiras!
es.R: Las personas que confían en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} son verdaderamente felices. No siguen a la gente orgullosa, ni a la gente que se aparta para seguir a dioses falsos.

decisions.choice: How blessed
decisions.reason: As in 1:1.

decisions.choice: the man: anyone who lives this way
decisions.reason: The word (gever) is a man in his strength, but the blessing is for everyone who trusts the LORD, as in 34:9.

decisions.choice: the proud, falsehood: people who rely on themselves or on lies
decisions.reason: The proud (rehavim) are the arrogant, who trust in themselves. Falsehood (kazav) is a lie; turning aside after it may mean following false gods (Amos 2:4).

decisions.choice: the person, their; "the man", "his" as the alternative
decisions.reason: The words describe anyone who trusts the LORD (m2).

decisions.choice: those, people (plural)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable speak of people in general, which needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: false gods
decisions.reason: Readable takes the falsehood to be false gods (m3).

source.text: רַבּ֤וֹת עָשִׂ֨יתָ׀אַתָּ֤ה׀יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהַי֮ נִֽפְלְאֹתֶ֥יךָ וּמַחְשְׁבֹתֶ֗יךָ אֵ֫לֵ֥ינוּ אֵ֤ין׀עֲרֹ֬ךְ אֵלֶ֗יךָ אַגִּ֥ידָה וַאֲדַבֵּ֑רָה עָ֝צְמ֗וּ מִסַּפֵּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Many [things] you have done, you, YHWH my God, your wonders and your plans toward us; there is none to compare to you; I would declare and speak [of them]; they are too many to count.

en.L: Many [things] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} plans for us; there is none to compare with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. [If] I would declare and speak [of them], they are too numerous to count.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done so many things, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wonders and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} plans for us; no one can compare with {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! If I tried to tell them all and speak of them, there would be more than I could count.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done so many wonderful things for us, and made so many plans for us. No one is like {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}! If I tried to tell about all of them, I could never finish.

fr.L: Nombreuses [sont les choses que] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as faites, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} desseins pour nous ; nul ne se compare à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. [Si] je voulais [les] annoncer et [en] parler, elles sont trop nombreuses pour être comptées.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de choses, {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} merveilles et {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} projets pour nous ; personne ne peut se comparer à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! Si j’essayais de les annoncer et d’en parler, il y en aurait plus que je ne pourrais compter.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de choses merveilleuses pour nous, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as fait tant de projets pour nous. Personne n’est comme {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ! Si j’essayais de les raconter toutes, je n’en finirais jamais.

sw.L: Mambo mengi umeyatenda, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa ajili yetu; hakuna wa kulinganishwa {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}. [Kama] ningeyatangaza na kuyanena, ni mengi mno kuhesabika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, umetenda mambo mengi sana, maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} na mipango {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa ajili yetu; hakuna anayeweza kulinganishwa {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}}! Kama ningejaribu kuyasimulia yote na kuyanena, yangekuwa mengi kuliko ninavyoweza kuhesabu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, umetutendea mambo mengi ya ajabu, na kutupangia mipango mingi. Hakuna aliye kama {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}! Kama ningejaribu kuyasimulia yote, nisingemaliza kamwe.

es.L: Muchas [cosas] has hecho {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} planes para con nosotros; no hay quien se compare contigo. [Si] yo [las] anunciara y hablara [de ellas], son demasiadas para contarlas.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho tantas cosas, {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} maravillas y {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} planes para nosotros; ¡nadie se puede comparar contigo! Si intentara contarlas todas y hablar de ellas, serían más de las que podría contar.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}} Dios mío, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has hecho muchísimas cosas maravillosas por nosotros, y has hecho muchísimos planes para nosotros. ¡Nadie es como {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}! Si intentara contarlas todas, nunca terminaría.

decisions.choice: your wonders: deeds only God can do
decisions.reason: The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts, above all the rescue from Egypt (9:2; Exodus 3:20).

decisions.choice: none to compare to you
alternatives: they cannot be set out in order before you
decisions.reason: The words may mean that nothing compares with God (89:7), or that his wonders cannot be laid out in order before him, they are so many. Either way the line goes on to say they cannot be counted.

decisions.choice: If (L in brackets)
decisions.reason: The two verbs are a condition without "if": were I to tell them, they would be too many.

source.text: זֶ֤בַח וּמִנְחָ֨ה׀לֹֽא־חָפַ֗צְתָּ אָ֭זְנַיִם כָּרִ֣יתָ לִּ֑י עוֹלָ֥ה וַ֝חֲטָאָ֗ה לֹ֣א שָׁאָֽלְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire; ears you dug for me; burnt offering and sin offering you did not ask.

en.L: Sacrifice and offering {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not desire — ears {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have dug for me — burnt offering and sin offering {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not ask for.
en.B: You took no pleasure in sacrifice and offering, but {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} opened my ears; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} did not ask for burnt offerings or sin offerings.
en.R: You did not really want animal sacrifices and gifts. Instead, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made me able to hear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and obey. You did not ask for animals to be burned on the altar or offered for sin.

fr.L: Sacrifice et offrande, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’[en] as pas désiré — des oreilles, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’en as creusé — ; holocauste et sacrifice pour le péché, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’[en] as pas demandé.
fr.B: Tu n’as pas pris plaisir au sacrifice et à l’offrande, mais {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as ouvert les oreilles ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} n’as pas demandé d’holocaustes ni de sacrifices pour le péché.
fr.R: Tu ne voulais pas vraiment des sacrifices d’animaux et des cadeaux. Tu m’as plutôt rendu capable de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}écouter et de {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}obéir. Tu n’as pas demandé qu’on brûle des animaux sur l’autel ou qu’on en offre pour le péché.

sw.L: Dhabihu na sadaka hukuzitaka — masikio umenichimbia — sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka ya dhambi hukuziomba.
sw.B: Hukupendezwa na dhabihu na sadaka, bali umeyafungua masikio yangu; hukuomba sadaka za kuteketezwa wala sadaka za dhambi.
sw.R: Hukutaka hasa dhabihu za wanyama na zawadi. Badala yake, umeniwezesha kukusikia na kutii. Hukuomba wanyama wateketezwe madhabahuni wala watolewe kwa ajili ya dhambi.

es.L: Sacrificio y ofrenda no {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradaron —oídos me has abierto—; holocausto y sacrificio por el pecado no pediste.
es.B: No {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} complaciste en sacrificios ni ofrendas, pero {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me abriste los oídos; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no pediste holocaustos ni sacrificios por el pecado.
es.R: En realidad {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no querías sacrificios de animales ni regalos. En cambio, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me hiciste capaz de oírte y obedecer. No pediste que se quemaran animales en el altar ni que se ofrecieran por el pecado.

decisions.choice: ears you dug for me: you made me able to hear and obey
alternatives: you pierced my ear (as a servant for life)
decisions.reason: To dig out ears is to open them, so that a person truly listens; in Hebrew to hear is also to obey (1 Samuel 15:22). Some see the ear of a servant pierced at the door as a mark of service for life (Exodus 21:6), but that uses a different word.

decisions.choice: sacrifice you did not desire: obedience comes first
decisions.reason: The four words cover the main offerings of the law. The psalm does not reject them; it says that what God wants first is a listening, willing heart (1 Samuel 15:22; 51:18-19; Hosea 6:6).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 10:5-7: a body you prepared for me
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:5-7 quotes verses 7-9 as the words of Christ coming into the world, from the ancient Greek translation, which reads "a body you prepared for me" instead of "ears you dug for me". The Hebrew text is followed here.

decisions.choice: made me able to hear you and obey
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

decisions.choice: "sadaka ya kuteketezwa" for burnt offering and "sadaka ya dhambi" for sin offering (L, B), as in the Pentateuch; Readable describes them
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch terms are kept so that readers can see the psalm speaking of the same offerings as the Law; Readable says what was done with the animals, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: oídos me has abierto
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says God "dug" ears for the psalmist. Spanish "cavar" said of ears would sound only strange, so Literal says "abierto", which keeps the picture of ears made able to hear; the meaning decision explains the image.

source.text: אָ֣ז אָ֭מַרְתִּי הִנֵּה־בָ֑אתִי בִּמְגִלַּת־סֵ֝֗פֶר כָּת֥וּב עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Then I said, Here I have come; in [the] scroll of [the] book [it is] written concerning me.

en.L: Then I said, "Look, I have come; in the scroll of the book [it is] written concerning me.
en.B: Then I said, "Here I come! What I must do is written down for me in the scroll of the book.
en.R: So I said, "I am here; I have come. The scroll of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} book tells me what I must do.

fr.L: Alors j’ai dit : « Voici, je suis venu ; dans le rouleau du livre [il est] écrit à mon sujet.
fr.B: Alors j’ai dit : « Me voici, je viens ! Ce que je dois faire est écrit pour moi dans le rouleau du livre.
fr.R: Alors j’ai dit : « Je suis là, je suis venu. Le rouleau de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} livre me dit ce que je dois faire.

sw.L: Ndipo niliposema, "Tazama, nimekuja; katika gombo la kitabu [ime]andikwa habari zangu.
sw.B: Ndipo niliposema, "Mimi hapa, ninakuja! Yale ninayopaswa kufanya yameandikwa kwa ajili yangu katika gombo la kitabu.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nilisema, "Mimi niko hapa; nimekuja. Gombo la kitabu {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} linaniambia ninachopaswa kufanya.

es.L: Entonces dije: «Mira, he venido; en el rollo del libro [está] escrito acerca de mí.
es.B: Entonces dije: «¡Aquí vengo! Lo que debo hacer está escrito para mí en el rollo del libro.
es.R: Así que dije: «Aquí estoy; he venido. El rollo de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} libro me dice lo que debo hacer.

decisions.choice: written concerning me: written for me to do
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean what is prescribed for a person, as in 2 Kings 22:13, "all that is written concerning us", which suits verse 9. Hebrews 10:7 hears it as "written about me".

decisions.choice: the scroll of the book: God's written instruction
decisions.reason: Books were written on scrolls. Here it is most likely the law of God (verse 9), which a king was to keep by him and read (Deuteronomy 17:18-19).

decisions.choice: the speech runs into verse 9
decisions.reason: What the psalmist said continues to the end of verse 9.

decisions.choice: your book
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear it is God's book (m2).

records.literal_gloss: To do your will, my God, I delight, and your instruction [is] in [the] midst of my inner parts.

en.L: To do {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} will, my God, I delight, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction [is] within my inmost being."
en.B: My God, I love to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction is deep inside me."
en.R: My God, I am glad to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} want. Your teaching is deep inside me."

fr.L: Faire {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} volonté, mon Dieu, voilà mon plaisir, et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi [est] au-dedans de mes entrailles. »
fr.B: Mon Dieu, j’aime faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux ; {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction est au fond de moi. »
fr.R: Mon Dieu, je suis heureux de faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} veux. Ton enseignement est au fond de moi. »

sw.L: Kufanya mapenzi {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, Mungu wangu, ninafurahia, na sheria {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [iko] ndani ya utu wangu wa ndani."
sw.B: Mungu wangu, ninapenda kufanya yale unayotaka; mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yamo ndani kabisa mwangu."
sw.R: Mungu wangu, ninafurahi kufanya yale unayotaka. Mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yamo ndani kabisa mwangu."

es.L: Hacer {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} voluntad, Dios mío, me deleita, y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción [está] dentro de mi ser más íntimo».
es.B: Dios mío, me encanta hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción está muy dentro de mí».
es.R: Dios mío, me alegra hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} quieres. Tu enseñanza está muy dentro de mí».

decisions.choice: instruction
decisions.reason: As in 1:2 (torah).

decisions.choice: in the midst of my inner parts: in my heart
decisions.reason: The inner parts (me'im) are the deepest self, where feeling and will are. The instruction is not only on a scroll but taken to heart (37:31; Jeremiah 31:33).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 10:7
decisions.reason: Hebrews 10:7-9 ends its quotation with "to do your will, O God" and sees it fulfilled in Christ.

source.text: בִּשַּׂ֤רְתִּי צֶ֨דֶק׀בְּקָ֘הָ֤ל רָ֗ב הִנֵּ֣ה שְׂ֭פָתַי לֹ֣א אֶכְלָ֑א יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַתָּ֥ה יָדָֽעְתָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: I have told good news [of] righteousness in [the] great assembly; look, my lips I do not hold back; YHWH, you know.

en.L: I have told the good news of righteousness in [the] great assembly; look, my lips I do not hold back; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know.
en.B: In the great assembly I have announced the good news of righteousness. I have not held my lips back; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know it, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: When {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people met together, I told them the good news that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do what is right. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know that I did not keep quiet.

fr.L: J’ai annoncé la bonne nouvelle de la justice dans [la] grande assemblée ; voici, je ne retiens pas mes lèvres ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais.
fr.B: Dans la grande assemblée j’ai annoncé la bonne nouvelle de la justice. Je n’ai pas retenu mes lèvres ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quand {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple s’est réuni, je lui ai annoncé la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais ce qui est juste. {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sais que je ne me suis pas tu.

sw.L: Nimetangaza habari njema ya haki katika kusanyiko kubwa; tazama, midomo yangu siizuii; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua.
sw.B: Katika kusanyiko kubwa nimetangaza habari njema ya haki. Sikuizuia midomo yangu; unalijua hilo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokutana pamoja, niliwaambia habari njema kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutenda yaliyo haki. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua kwamba sikunyamaza.

es.L: He anunciado la buena noticia de [la] justicia en [la] gran asamblea; mira, mis labios no he refrenado; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} [lo] sabes.
es.B: En la gran asamblea he anunciado la buena noticia de la justicia. No he refrenado mis labios; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} lo sabes, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cuando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo se reunió, les conté la buena noticia de que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces lo que es justo. {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes que no me quedé callado.

decisions.choice: told good news
decisions.reason: The verb (bisser) is to bring good news, as a messenger does (Isaiah 40:9; 52:7).

decisions.choice: righteousness: God's right acts of rescue
decisions.reason: The righteousness he announces is the LORD's: his faithful, just way of putting things right by saving his people (verse 11).

decisions.choice: the great assembly: the people gathered for worship
that you do what is right
decisions.reason: Readable says whose righteousness it is (m2).

source.text: צִדְקָתְךָ֬ לֹא־כִסִּ֨יתִי׀בְּת֬וֹךְ לִבִּ֗י אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ וּתְשׁוּעָתְךָ֣ אָמָ֑רְתִּי לֹא־כִחַ֥דְתִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ לְקָהָ֥ל רָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: Your righteousness I have not hidden in [the] midst of my heart; your faithfulness and your salvation I have spoken; I have not concealed your loyal love and your truth from [the] great assembly.

en.L: Your righteousness I have not hidden within my heart; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation I have spoken; I have not concealed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth from [the] great assembly.
en.B: Your justice I did not keep shut up in my heart; I talked of how faithful {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are and how {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} rescue. Your loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth I did not hide from the great assembly.
en.R: I did not keep to myself how good and fair {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are. I told people that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful and that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save. I did not hide {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} people when they gathered.

fr.L: Ta justice, je ne l’ai pas cachée au-dedans de mon cœur ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité et {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut, je les ai dits ; je n’ai pas dissimulé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité à [la] grande assemblée.
fr.B: Ta justice, je ne l’ai pas tenue enfermée dans mon cœur ; j’ai dit combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle et comment {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sauves. Ton amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité, je ne les ai pas cachés à la grande assemblée.
fr.R: Je n’ai pas gardé pour moi combien {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es bon et juste. J’ai dit aux gens que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sauves. Je n’ai pas caché {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} peuple quand il était réuni.

sw.L: Haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikuificha ndani ya moyo wangu; uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} na wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} nimeunena; sikuuficha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.
sw.B: Haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikuifungia moyoni mwangu; nilisimulia jinsi ulivyo mwaminifu na jinsi unavyookoa. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikuvificha mbele ya kusanyiko kubwa.
sw.R: Sikuficha moyoni jinsi ulivyo mwema na wa haki. Niliwaambia watu kwamba {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu na kwamba unaokoa. Sikuuficha upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} mbele ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} walipokusanyika.

es.L: Tu justicia no he escondido dentro de mi corazón; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación he proclamado; no he ocultado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad a [la] gran asamblea.
es.B: Tu justicia no la guardé encerrada en mi corazón; hablé de lo fiel que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} y de cómo {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} rescatas. Tu amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad no los oculté a la gran asamblea.
es.R: No me guardé para mí lo bueno y justo que eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}. Le dije a la gente que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel y que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} salvas. No escondí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel ni {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pueblo cuando se reunía.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: not hidden, not concealed: openly told
decisions.reason: Saying what he did not do is a strong way of saying what he did: he told it all, out loud. The verse takes up "I do not hold back" from verse 10.

decisions.choice: faithfulness, truth: God can be relied on
decisions.reason: Both words ('emunah, 'emet) come from the root of "amen": what is firm and holds.

source.text: אַתָּ֤ה יְהוָ֗ה לֹא־תִכְלָ֣א רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ מִמֶּ֑נִּי חַסְדְּךָ֥ וַ֝אֲמִתְּךָ֗ תָּמִ֥יד יִצְּרֽוּנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: You, YHWH, will not withhold your compassion from me; your loyal love and your truth continually will guard me.

en.L: You, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, will not withhold {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion from me; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth will continually guard me.
en.B: And {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, will not hold back {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tender mercy from me; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth will guard me always.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will not stop being kind to me. Your faithful love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} truth will always keep me safe.

fr.L: Toi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne retiendras pas loin de moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} compassion ; {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité me garderont continuellement.
fr.B: Et {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne me refuseras pas {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendresse ; {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité me garderont toujours.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne cesseras pas d’être bon pour moi. Ton amour fidèle et {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vérité me protégeront toujours.

sw.L: Wewe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hutazuia huruma {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwangu; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} vitanilinda daima.
sw.B: Nawe, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, hutanizuilia huruma {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nyororo; upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} vitanilinda siku zote.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} hutaacha kunitendea wema. Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma na kweli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} vitanilinda salama siku zote.

es.L: Tú, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no retendrás de mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad me guardarán continuamente.
es.B: Y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, no me negarás {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierna misericordia; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad me guardarán siempre.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no dejarás de ser bueno conmigo. Tu amor fiel y {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} verdad siempre me mantendrán a salvo.

decisions.choice: withhold: a play on verse 10
decisions.reason: The verb (kala') is the one in verse 10: he did not hold back his lips, and the LORD will not hold back his compassion.

decisions.choice: will not withhold, will guard: trust, or a prayer
alternatives: do not withhold ...; may your loyal love guard me
decisions.reason: The verbs can be read as confident statements or as requests. Both fit the turn to prayer in the next verses.

decisions.choice: compassion: tender, motherly mercy
decisions.reason: The word (rachamim) is related to the word for the womb.

source.text: כִּ֤י אָפְפ֥וּ־עָלַ֨י׀רָע֡וֹת עַד־אֵ֬ין מִסְפָּ֗ר הִשִּׂיג֣וּנִי עֲ֭וֺנֹתַי וְלֹא־יָכֹ֣לְתִּי לִרְא֑וֹת עָצְמ֥וּ מִשַּֽׂעֲר֥וֹת רֹ֝אשִׁ֗י וְלִבִּ֥י עֲזָבָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: For evils have surrounded me until [there is] no number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I am not able to see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.

en.L: For evils have surrounded me beyond number; my iniquities have overtaken me, and I am not able to see; they are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart has forsaken me.
en.B: Troubles too many to count have closed in around me; my sins have caught up with me, and I cannot see. They outnumber the hairs on my head, and my courage has left me.
en.R: So many troubles are all around me that I cannot count them. My sins have caught up with me, and I cannot see where to go. They are more than the hairs on my head. I have lost all courage.

fr.L: Car des maux m’ont entouré sans nombre ; mes fautes m’ont atteint, et je ne peux plus voir ; elles sont plus nombreuses que les cheveux de ma tête, et mon cœur m’a abandonné.
fr.B: Des malheurs trop nombreux pour être comptés se sont refermés sur moi ; mes péchés m’ont rattrapé, et je n’y vois plus. Ils sont plus nombreux que les cheveux de ma tête, et le courage m’a quitté.
fr.R: Il y a tant de malheurs autour de moi que je ne peux pas les compter. Mes péchés m’ont rattrapé, et je ne vois plus où aller. Ils sont plus nombreux que les cheveux sur ma tête. J’ai perdu tout courage.

sw.L: Kwa maana mabaya yasiyo na hesabu yamenizunguka; maovu yangu yamenipata, wala siwezi kuona; ni mengi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, na moyo wangu umeniacha.
sw.B: Taabu nyingi mno kuhesabika zimenizingira; dhambi zangu zimenifikia, nami siwezi kuona. Ni nyingi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu, na ujasiri wangu umeniacha.
sw.R: Taabu nyingi sana zimenizunguka hata siwezi kuzihesabu. Dhambi zangu zimenipata, nami siwezi kuona niende wapi. Ni nyingi kuliko nywele za kichwa changu. Nimepoteza ujasiri wote.

es.L: Porque males sin número me han rodeado; mis iniquidades me han alcanzado, y no puedo ver; son más que los cabellos de mi cabeza, y mi corazón me ha abandonado.
es.B: Problemas que no se pueden contar me han cercado; mis pecados me han alcanzado, y no puedo ver. Son más que los cabellos de mi cabeza, y el valor me ha abandonado.
es.R: Tengo tantos problemas a mi alrededor que no los puedo contar. Mis pecados me han alcanzado, y no puedo ver hacia dónde ir. Son más que los cabellos de mi cabeza. He perdido todo el valor.

decisions.choice: evils, iniquities: troubles and the sins behind them
decisions.reason: The evils (ra'ot) are troubles that come on him; his iniquities ('avonot) are his own sins, which can also mean the punishment they bring. He does not separate the two.

decisions.choice: I am not able to see: I am overwhelmed
decisions.reason: Not being able to see may mean that troubles hide everything else, or that his eyes fail from weakness and grief (38:11).

decisions.choice: my heart has forsaken me: my courage is gone
decisions.reason: The heart is the inner self; when it leaves, strength and courage go too (38:11).

decisions.choice: where to go
decisions.reason: Readable gives one sense of not being able to see (m2).

source.text: רְצֵ֣ה יְ֭הוָה לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: Be pleased, YHWH, to deliver me; YHWH, to my help hurry.

en.L: Be pleased, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, to rescue me; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hurry to my help!
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, be willing to rescue me! {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, hurry and help me!
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, please save me! {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, come quickly and help me!

fr.L: Veuille, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, me délivrer ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, hâte-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} [de venir] à mon secours !
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, accepte de me délivrer ! {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, viens vite à mon aide !
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, sauve-moi, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie ! {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, viens vite m’aider !

es.L: Ten a bien, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, librarme; {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, ¡apresúrate a ayudarme!

decisions.choice: Psalm 70:2
decisions.reason: Verses 14-18 are repeated as Psalm 70 (70:2-6), where the first line begins with "God" and lacks "be pleased".

decisions.choice: be pleased: be willing, accept
decisions.reason: The verb (ratsah) is used of God accepting a person or an offering with favor.

source.text: יֵ֘בֹ֤שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּר֨וּ׀יַחַד֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י נַפְשִׁ֗י לִסְפּ֫וֹתָ֥הּ יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: May they be ashamed and abashed together, those who seek my life to snatch it away; may they be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.

en.L: May they be ashamed and abashed together, those who seek my life to snatch it away; may they be turned back and humiliated, those who desire my harm.
en.B: Let those who hunt for my life to snatch it away be shamed and confounded, all of them; let those who wish me harm be driven back and humiliated.
en.R: Some people are trying to kill me. Make all of them ashamed and confused. Some people want to hurt me. Make them turn back in shame.

fr.L: Qu’ils soient honteux et confus ensemble, ceux qui cherchent ma vie pour l’enlever ; qu’ils reculent et soient humiliés, ceux qui désirent mon malheur.
fr.B: Que ceux qui pourchassent ma vie pour me l’arracher soient tous humiliés et confondus ; que ceux qui me veulent du mal soient repoussés et couverts de honte.
fr.R: Des gens essaient de me tuer. Fais-les tous avoir honte et perdre leurs moyens. Des gens veulent me faire du mal. Fais-les reculer, couverts de honte.

sw.L: Waaibike na kufedheheka pamoja wale wanaoutafuta uhai wangu ili kuuondoa; warudishwe nyuma na kuaibishwa wale wanaotamani madhara yangu.
sw.B: Wale wanaowinda uhai wangu ili kuunyakua waaibishwe na kuchanganyikiwa, wote pamoja; wale wanaonitakia mabaya warudishwe nyuma na kudhalilishwa.
sw.R: Kuna watu wanaojaribu kuniua. Uwaaibishe wote na kuwachanganya. Kuna watu wanaotaka kunidhuru. Uwafanye warudi nyuma kwa aibu.

es.L: Sean avergonzados y confundidos a una los que buscan mi vida para arrebatarla; vuelvan atrás y sean humillados los que desean mi mal.
es.B: Que todos los que andan a la caza de mi vida para arrebatarla queden avergonzados y confundidos; que los que me desean el mal retrocedan humillados.
es.R: Hay gente que trata de matarme. Haz que todos ellos queden avergonzados y confundidos. Hay gente que quiere hacerme daño. Haz que se vuelvan atrás avergonzados.

decisions.choice: may they be ashamed: a prayer against enemies
decisions.reason: The verbs are wishes. He asks that their plans fail and that they be shown up, the shame they meant for him falling on them (35:4, 26).

decisions.choice: seek my life: try to kill me
decisions.reason: As in 35:4.

decisions.choice: Make them ...
decisions.reason: Readable puts the wishes as requests to the LORD.

source.text: יָ֭שֹׁמּוּ עַל־עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָאֹמְרִ֥ים לִ֝֗י הֶ֘אָ֥ח׀הֶאָֽח׃

records.literal_gloss: May they be appalled because of their shame, those who say to me, Aha, aha!

en.L: May they be appalled on account of their shame, those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!"
en.B: Let those who jeer at me, "Aha! Aha!", be stunned by their own shame.
en.R: Some people laugh at me and say, "Ha! Ha!" Let them be shocked when they are put to shame.

fr.L: Qu’ils soient consternés à cause de leur honte, ceux qui me disent : « Ah ! ah ! »
fr.B: Que ceux qui me lancent : « Ah ! ah ! » restent stupéfaits de leur propre honte.
fr.R: Des gens se moquent de moi et disent : « Ha ! ha ! » Qu’ils soient bouleversés quand ils seront couverts de honte.

sw.L: Washangazwe kwa sababu ya aibu yao wale wanaoniambia, "Aha! Aha!"
sw.B: Wale wanaonizomea, "Aha! Aha!", wapigwe butwaa kwa aibu yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Kuna watu wanaonicheka na kusema, "Ha! Ha!" Washtuke watakapoaibishwa.

es.L: Queden espantados a causa de su vergüenza los que me dicen: «¡Ajá! ¡Ajá!».
es.B: Que los que se burlan de mí diciendo: «¡Ajá! ¡Ajá!», queden pasmados por su propia vergüenza.
es.R: Hay gente que se ríe de mí y dice: «¡Ja! ¡Ja!». Que se queden asombrados cuando sean avergonzados.

decisions.choice: Aha, aha: a gloating laugh
decisions.reason: The cry is the glee of enemies at someone's fall (35:21, 25; Ezekiel 25:3).

decisions.choice: appalled because of: stunned as the reward of
decisions.reason: The verb (shamem) means to be stunned or laid waste; "because of" ('eqev) is "as the result of": their own shame comes back on them.

source.text: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ׀בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ יֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה אֹֽ֝הֲבֵ֗י תְּשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: May they exult and rejoice in you, all who seek you; may they say continually, Great [is] YHWH, those who love your salvation.

en.L: May they exult and rejoice in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, all who seek {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; may they say continually, "Great is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!" those who love {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation.
en.B: But may everyone who looks for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} shout for joy and find gladness in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; may those who love to see {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save never stop saying, "How great {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is!"
en.R: But let all who come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} be happy and glad because of {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Let all who love it when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} save them always say, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great!"

fr.L: Qu’ils exultent et se réjouissent en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent ; qu’ils disent continuellement : « Grand est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! », ceux qui aiment {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut.
fr.B: Mais que tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} cherchent crient de joie et trouvent en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} leur bonheur ; que ceux qui aiment {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} voir sauver ne cessent de dire : « Qu’il est grand, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! »
fr.R: Mais que tous ceux qui viennent vers {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} soient heureux et joyeux grâce à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Que tous ceux qui aiment que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} les sauves disent toujours : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand ! »

sw.L: Washangilie na kufurahi ndani {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} wote wanaokutafuta {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; waseme daima, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu!" wale wanaoupenda wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Lakini kila anayekutafuta {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} apige kelele za furaha na kupata furaha ndani {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; wale wanaopenda kukuona ukiokoa wasiache kamwe kusema, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu kama nini!"
sw.R: Lakini wote wanaokuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} wafurahi na kushangilia kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Wote wanaopenda unapowaokoa waseme siku zote, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu!"

es.L: Gócense y alégrense en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan; digan siempre: «¡Grande es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}!» los que aman {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación.
es.B: Pero que todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} buscan griten de alegría y encuentren su gozo en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}; que los que aman verte salvar nunca dejen de decir: «¡Qué grande es {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}!».
es.R: Pero que todos los que vienen a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} estén felices y alegres por causa {{deity_pronoun:tuya|Tuya}}. Que todos los que se alegran cuando {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} los salvas digan siempre: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande!».

decisions.choice: Great is the LORD: praise, or a wish
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as a wish, "may the LORD be great", that is, be shown and praised as great (35:27). Said by those he has saved, it is praise.

decisions.choice: those who seek you: those who turn to God in worship and prayer
decisions.reason: To seek the LORD is to come to him for help and to worship him (9:11; 24:6).

decisions.choice: But
decisions.reason: The wish for those who seek the LORD is set against the wish for the enemies.

source.text: וַאֲנִ֤י׀עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֲדֹנָ֪י יַחֲשָׁ֫ב לִ֥י עֶזְרָתִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה אֱ֝לֹהַ֗י אַל־תְּאַחַֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And I [am] afflicted and needy; [the] Lord will think of me; my help and my deliverer [are] you; my God, do not delay.

en.L: But I [am] poor and needy; may [the] Lord think of me. My help and my deliverer [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; my God, do not delay!
en.B: As for me, I am poor and in need; may the Lord keep me in mind. You are the one who helps me and sets me free; my God, do not be slow!
en.R: I am poor and in need. May the Lord remember me. You help me and save me. My God, please come quickly!

fr.L: Mais moi, [je suis] pauvre et indigent ; que [le] Seigneur pense à moi. Mon secours et mon libérateur, [c’est] {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; mon Dieu, ne tarde pas !
fr.B: Quant à moi, je suis pauvre et dans le besoin ; que le Seigneur se souvienne de moi. C’est {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui me secours et qui me libères ; mon Dieu, ne tarde pas !
fr.R: Je suis pauvre et dans le besoin. Que le Seigneur se souvienne de moi. Tu m’aides et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves. Mon Dieu, viens vite, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie !

sw.L: Lakini mimi [ni] mnyonge na mhitaji; Bwana na anifikirie. Msaada wangu na mwokozi wangu [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}; Mungu wangu, usikawie!
sw.B: Lakini mimi, ni mnyonge na mhitaji; Bwana na anikumbuke. Wewe ndiwe unayenisaidia na kuniweka huru; Mungu wangu, usichelewe!
sw.R: Mimi ni maskini na mhitaji. Bwana na anikumbuke. Wewe hunisaidia na kuniokoa. Mungu wangu, tafadhali njoo upesi!

es.L: Pero yo [soy] pobre y necesitado; piense en mí [el] Señor. Mi ayuda y mi libertador [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}; Dios mío, ¡no te demores!
es.B: En cuanto a mí, soy pobre y necesitado; que el Señor me tenga presente. Tú eres el que me ayuda y me pone en libertad; Dios mío, ¡no tardes!
es.R: Yo soy pobre y necesitado. Que el Señor se acuerde de mí. Tú me ayudas y me salvas. Dios mío, ¡por favor, ven pronto!

decisions.choice: afflicted and needy: helpless and dependent on God
decisions.reason: As in 35:10; the pair describes those who have no help but the LORD.

decisions.choice: will think of me: may he think of me
decisions.reason: The verb can be a statement or a wish. Psalm 70:6 has "God, hurry to me" here.

decisions.choice: the Lord
decisions.reason: Here the title 'Adonai, "Lord" or "my Lord", is used, not the divine name.
